verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms posthog.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a PostHog summary. The docs are served as per-page markdown (e.g. /docs/product-analytics.md, /docs/cli.md), and PostHog ships agent-oriented material: downloadable SKILL.md bundles (also confirmed live by probe), and CLI and plugin installs that add instructions to your coding agent. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming llms.txt, a root /docs.md index (probe returned 404), visibility into the full llms.txt contents.
